description: Full Form M-1 filing history for one named MEWA or sponsor — every plan year it filed, newest first, plus a count. Matches the name against both the MEWA name and the sponsor name, or pass an exact EIN instead. Use to answer "has this MEWA/association health plan filed Form M-1, and for which years" or "is this plan still registered".

ein.description: MEWA EIN (9 digits, dashes optional), exact match. Provide this or `name`.

name.description: MEWA or sponsor name, matched as a substring against both fields.
